expect_nodes.note: the consumer: `include Import["user_service"]`, the dry-auto_inject builder over the dry-container `Container`

expect_edges.note: dry-auto_inject key `user_service` -> UserService: container.rb registers exactly that class (`register("user_service") { UserService.new }`), and dry-system's inflection of the key gives the same name. Measured absent before DH.13 (the Ruby parser had no INJECTS site).

note: DH.13 rewrite of the A15.12 probe: the old source required dry/container but used none of it, and its `def initialize(user_service)` was an untyped parameter that names no type, so no DI fact existed in the source. Now the real dry-rb API (dry-rb.org/gems/dry-auto_inject): `Import = Dry::AutoInject(Container)` + `include Import["user_service"]`, the container registering the key. Same classes, same expected INJECTS edge.
